title: VendPoint Usage Billing Still to Post: Estimate Used in Commercial Credit Account Room Payments
content:
A room payment on a Commercial Credit Account counts **the VendPoint billing still to post**, an amount added to the receivable balance, read from the monthly usage bills and fees on the customer's VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machines.

### Clause

The VendPoint billing still to post is read from the usage billed on all the customer's VendPoint machines and is nothing when no usage was billed on them in the last three whole months; otherwise it is a usage estimate plus the cellular data fees charged on those machines dated less than one whole month before today, where the estimate is the larger of the latest month's usage plus its rise over the month before and the largest monthly minimum usage among the customer's active VendPoint machines when usage was billed in each of the months less than one whole month, one whole month and two whole months before today and each of those months' usage exceeds the month before it, the usage of the last three whole months divided by three when usage was billed two whole months before today otherwise, and the usage of the latest month within the last two whole months that carries usage when usage was billed only within those two months.

Months are counted in whole months between the usage bill's date and today (the difference in calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day). The last three whole months are the 3 months less than three whole months before today. The monthly minimum usage of an active machine is the minimum monthly usage figure of its VendPoint model.

### Method by usage pattern

| Usage billed | Estimate |
|---|---|
| in each of the three months, each month above the month before | the larger of the latest month plus its rise over the month before, and the largest model minimum monthly usage among the active machines |
| two whole months before today, not rising in all three | the usage of the last three whole months divided by three |
| only within the last two whole months | the usage of the latest month of those two that carries usage |
| none in the last three whole months | nothing (no billing still to post, no cellular fees added) |

In the first three rows the cellular data fees dated less than one whole month before today are added to the estimate.

### Example (hypothetical)

Usage of 900.00, 1100.00 and 1400.00 in the months two, one and less than one whole month before today; largest active model minimum 1250.00; cellular fees 15.00. Rising: 1400.00 plus its 300.00 rise is 1700.00, larger than 1250.00; billing still to post 1715.00. With 1400.00, 900.00 and 1100.00 instead (not rising): 3400.00 divided by 3, plus 15.00, about 1148.33 before the room payment is rounded on its final figure.
